rule_name: VDU-1 White Marker Board By Others Note Validation

view_matching_logic.Elevation: Check whether VDU-1 / White Marker Board is shown, tagged, or annotated in the elevation view. Validate that the required BY OTHERS note is placed near the VDU-1 callout, leader, or board boundary.

geometry_logic.boundary_detection: Detect VDU-1 / White Marker Board scope by identifying VDU-1 tag, leader arrow, callout text, schedule reference, wall-mounted rectangular board outline, or annotation linked to the board object.
wall_interaction_conditions: VDU-1 tag is visible in the drawing view
VDU-1 is mapped to WHITE MARKER BOARD in the schedule
White Marker Board rectangular boundary is visible
Leader line connects VDU-1 callout to board object
Board is mounted on or aligned with wall/elevation surface
geometry_logic.expected_boundary_region: Around the VDU-1 tag, leader arrow endpoint, White Marker Board outline, wall-mounted board boundary, or nearby annotation area connected to the VDU-1 object.

pass_condition: Arch drawing has VDU-1 or WHITE MARKER BOARD AND submittal has VDU-1 BY OTHERS note.
fail_condition: Arch drawing has VDU-1 but submittal is missing VDU-1 BY OTHERS note.
VDU-1 scope confirmed from arch but no BY OTHERS responsibility note found in submittal.
review_required_condition: VDU-1 scope is applicable but the note text is unclear or partially readable.
VDU-1 tag is visible but its connected object or leader region is unclear.
Schedule shows VDU-1 as White Marker Board, but drawing location is ambiguous.
Multiple nearby notes create uncertainty about whether the BY OTHERS note belongs to VDU-1.
omit_condition: Arch drawing does not contain VDU-1 — scope not applicable.
ARCH REF not found in submittal and arch drawing not available.
Drawing sheet does not contain VDU-1 scope.

reasoning.description: Explain whether VDU-1 / White Marker Board scope is applicable, whether the BY OTHERS responsibility note is found, and why the final status is PASS, FAIL, OMITTED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED.

view_results.view_type: Detected actual view title from drawing
